plan.failureSummary: The Briefcase chatbot backend fails with HTTP 500 errors on /api/chat requests, preventing the chatbot from generating responses.
observedIndicators: Network logs reveal multiple HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses when making POST requests to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat.
Page AI flow stopped with 'Objective not completable' because the chatbot failed to generate any responses to user prompts.
Failure screenshot confirms user prompts are displayed in the chat interface but no bot response is generated.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix server-side 500 Internal Server Error on the /api/chat endpoint
remediationSteps.details: Examine the server logs and backend handlers for the /api/chat endpoint on https://briefcase.chat to resolve the 500 Internal Server Error occurring during chat completions (e.g. LLM API configuration, credentials, or runtime exceptions).

plan.notes: The test uses page.ai to evaluate chatbot topic compliance. When prompts were submitted, the backend /api/chat endpoint returned 500 Internal Server Errors (visible in browser/network logs), causing no assistant responses to render and failing the objective.
